name: Arm Break

Arrow/Bowgun/Bow only Type Active, Physical skill Element Neutral MP 700 $result_string .= sprintf("Aggro %s", $row['aggro_text']); Combo start Yes Combo middle Yes Range 14 Description Attack a target's arm and reduce its attack power. Neutral element attack. Dual Element with Arrow . Chance to inflict [Lethargy] on the target and when successful, damage dealt greatly increases. Bow Power +300 Lethargy Rate +20% Bowgun Power +350 Lethargy Rate -20% Arrow Lethargy Rate +20% Extras Show more...
